desc: The Magpul PRS Lite stock takes all the popular features of the PRS stock and puts it in a lightweight skeletonized profile for those looking to build a DMR style rifle without adding a ton of weight. All the adjustability you need is built right into this lightweight precision stock like length of pull, and cheek comb height, so you can get into the perfect position no matter the terrain. While these adjustments are not toolless, the simpler design helps reduce the weight by 10 ounces when compared to the PRS Gen 3. The PRS Lite stock is compatible with carbine, SR25, and A5 length receiver extension tubes for both .223 and .308 pattern rifles. Build your next DMR with the lightweight and lower cost Magpul PRS Lite stock.
